profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company founded in 1975, headquartered in Redmond, WA, USA, and traded as MSFT. Its last reported revenue, for the period ending 2026-06-30 in a 10-K filing, was $331,839,000,000. The company's Power Automate site describes software for automating workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI, digital, and robotic process automation. The site quotes customers saying a data validation and standardization process that once took over 100 people can be managed by just a few people with generative AI and Power Automate, and citing alignment with the Power Platform ecosystem.

Microsoft's tracked AI products span several areas. Microsoft Copilot is embedded across M365, and Microsoft Power Automate AI covers enterprise workflow automation with Copilot integration, M365 data access, and DLP integration. Cloud offerings include Azure Machine Learning, an MLOps platform with AutoML, a model registry, and responsible AI toolkit integration, and Azure OpenAI Service, which runs OpenAI models in Azure regions with enterprise content filtering, Entra ID integration, and data residency controls. Developer tools include AutoGen, a multi-agent conversation framework from Microsoft Research, Semantic Kernel, a model-agnostic orchestration SDK for .NET, Python, and Java that the material says is superseded by Microsoft Agent Framework in 2026, and Microsoft Agent Framework itself, described as the successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen with graph workflows and native MCP and A2A support. Other products include Microsoft Designer, Microsoft Teams AI, SharePoint AI, and Microsoft Clipchamp AI. A set of education products is also tracked, among them Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for Education, Microsoft Immersive Reader, Microsoft Translator, Microsoft Seeing AI, Microsoft Reading Coach, and Microsoft Forms, several of which the material notes were found in research for The AI Ready School and not independently verified.

Two lawsuits are recorded against the company in the U.S. District Court, S.D. New York: The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. Washington state is listed with 114 cases in the company's law exposure record.
